name: Gangplank
notes: Opens with Cannon Barrage (R) at t=0: 12 magic-damage waves in 4 clusters of 3, clusters 2s apart, waves within a cluster 0.25s apart; this uses the wiki's stated intra-cluster delay of 0.25s rather than the disagreeing bin field GangplankR.CannonDelay=0.5, since the wiki explicitly describes the cadence in prose.
Parrrley (Q) is cast every time it is off cooldown (4.5s) throughout the fight; its physical damage can critically strike and is dealt as ability damage.

Trial by Fire (P) automatically empowers the next basic attack once its 15s cooldown (reduced by ability haste) is up; the empowered attack deals its true-damage burn as 10 ticks of 0.25s over 2.5s, using the byLevel array already linearly interpolated between the wiki's confirmed level 1 (50) and level 18 (250) endpoints.
Powder Keg (E) is deliberately not modeled as a damage source: see the top-level 'unused' entry for why.
Remove Scurvy (W) is never cast: it is a pure self-heal/cleanse with no damage-fight relevance.
Mana is not modeled: at level 16 Gangplank's mana pool and item sustain comfortably cover a 4.5s-cooldown Q and a single 15s+ cooldown R inside an 8-15s fight.
Gangplank is treated as melee per the supplied base attack stats.

unused.E: Powder Keg is a two-stage place-then-destroy trap: Gangplank places a keg (a separate destructible entity, 3 health) and must then hit it with a basic attack or Parrrley to detonate it, at which point the explosion deals the TRIGGERING ATTACK's own damage (plus a flat champion-only bonus and its own armor pen) to nearby enemies - it is not a fixed spell-damage instance of its own. Modeling this against a single stationary dummy would require inventing unsourced assumptions the dossier itself flags as unsettled: whether the triggering attack hits the dummy AND is separately re-dealt as the explosion (double-counting), how many kegs are placed/detonated inside a short fight, and how often Trial by Fire's cooldown is reset by keg explosions. Since every reasonable choice here is a guess rather than a number the sources state, Powder Keg is left out of the damage-fight rotation rather than approximated; the dossier notes this likely undercounts Gangplank's total damage somewhat.

assumed.why: levels 2-17 are linearly interpolated by the source dossier between the wiki's confirmed level 1 (50) and level 18 (250) endpoints; neither the sheet nor the wiki give intermediate per-level values directly
